steps.help: The chain in order from left to right. A step's lane is only its vertical position; its place in the chain is not affected by it.

title.help: The title of the step, a short name for the activity.

description.help: The description of the step, free text.

laneId.help: The lane of the step: a role or department from the sidebar, or “Unassigned” while nobody owns it yet.

substeps.help: The sub-steps of the step in order.

lanes.help: The lanes (roles or departments) in display order from top to bottom. The reserved “Unassigned” lane carries no name of its own and can be neither renamed nor removed.

name.help: The name of the role or department.

expanded.help: The steps whose sub-steps are expanded; display only.

addStep.help: Inserts an empty step into the chain and returns its id. Without a lane it lands in “Unassigned”.

params.command: The command as an object, optionally with index and laneId.
params.index: Position of the new step in the chain after inserting (0 = the very front, the number of steps = at the end). Without it the step is appended. A value outside that range or a non-integer is an error.
params.laneId: The id of an existing lane, or 'unassigned' for “Unassigned” (that lane is created when needed). Defaults to 'unassigned'. An unknown id is an error.

removeStep.help: Removes a step together with its sub-steps from the chain.

params.command: The command as an object with id.
params.id: The id of the step to remove. An unknown id is an error.

moveStep.help: Moves a step to another place in the chain and optionally sets its lane at the same time.

params.command: The command as an object with id, index and optionally laneId.
params.id: The id of the step to move. An unknown id is an error.
params.index: The position of the step after the move, a whole number from 0 (the very front) to the number of steps minus one.
params.laneId: Optional: the new lane, the id of an existing lane or 'unassigned'. Without it the lane stays. An unknown id is an error.

setLaneForStep.help: Assigns a step to a lane; its place in the chain stays.

params.command: The command as an object with stepId and laneId.
params.stepId: The id of the step. An unknown id is an error.
params.laneId: The id of an existing lane, or 'unassigned' for “Unassigned”. An unknown id is an error.

addLane.help: Appends an unnamed lane at the bottom and returns its id.

params.command: The command as an empty object; it takes no input.

removeLane.help: Removes a lane; its steps move to “Unassigned” and are never lost with the lane. The “Unassigned” lane itself cannot be removed.

params.command: The command as an object with laneId.
params.laneId: The id of the lane. An unknown id or 'unassigned' is an error.

addSubstep.help: Adds an empty sub-step to a step. Returns the id of the new sub-step.

params.command: The command as an object with stepId.
params.stepId: The id of the step that gets the new sub-step. An unknown id is an error.

removeSubstep.help: Removes a sub-step from its parent step.

params.command: The command as an object with stepId and substepId.
params.stepId: The id of the parent step. An unknown id is an error.
params.substepId: The id of the sub-step to remove. An unknown id is an error.

moveSubstep.help: Moves a sub-step to another position within its step.

params.command: The command as an object with stepId, substepId and index.
params.stepId: The id of the step the sub-step belongs to. An unknown id is an error.
params.substepId: The id of the sub-step to move. An unknown id is an error.
params.index: The position of the sub-step after the move, a whole number from 0 (the very front) to the number of sub-steps of the step minus one.

setExpanded.help: Shows or hides a step's sub-steps; display only, the content stays.

params.command: The command as an object with id and expanded.
params.id: The id of the step whose sub-steps are shown or hidden. An unknown id is an error.
params.expanded: true shows the sub-steps, false hides them.

appendSteps.help: Appends several steps to the end of the chain, for example taken over from another instance; all of them land in “Unassigned”. Returns the number of appended steps.

params.command: The command as an object with steps.
params.steps: The steps to append as a list; each entry has title and description.
